newsitem.title: UK: Safeway offers 5 pct interest on ABC card.
newsitem.headline: Safeway offers 5 pct interest on ABC card.

text.p: British supermarket chain Safeway Plc on Monday launched its ABC bonus account card, which it is setting up with high-street bank Abbey National, would offer five percent gross interest on balances up to 600 stg.
The new card, which is supposed to offer a completely new approach to shopping, allows customers to pay household bills and shopping from a single account.
Safeway, Britain's third largest supermarket chain, upped the stakes in a battle for customer loyalty last November by teaming up with Abbey National to offer banking services via its ABC card.

Safeway said purchases will be authorised on-line and money will be debited from the account immediately -- putting shoppers in total control of exactly how much they want to spend. It will also allow cardholders to collect ABC points when shopping.

There would be an immediate 500 ABC points bonus for customers opening an account -- plus double ABC points for the first 12 weeks when shopping in Safeway with the card. Accounts can be opened from the end of this month and customers can use their cards from early March.
Safeway customers will be able to use ABC bonus account card at Safeway and any store displaying the Electron sign.
All 5.6 million of Safeway's existing ABC cardholders will be eligible to apply for the ABC Bonus Account, which will be managed by Abbey National.
A range of other financial services would follow, which Safeway said could include a current account with an overdraft facility and a credit card.

The two companies, whose link follows moves by rivals Tesco Plc and J. Sainsbury into financial services, are also working together to develop technology to provide in-store banking and easy access to financial services from personal loans to household insurance.

"The ABC Bonus Account is so much more than just an ordinary debit or credit card account and is the latest, logical extension of Safeway's aim to make shopping easier for today's families," said Colin Smith, Safeway's chief executive.
The Safeway ABC Bonus Account Card will be accepted in Safeway stores as well as 70,000 UK outlets which accept Visa's Electron on-line debit card.

These include C&A, Deep Pan Pizza, Dollond & Aitchison, Granada, Lillywhites, Monsoon, Moss Bros, Our Price, Toys 'R' Us and Virgin. One ABC point is earned every time a customer spends one pound in a Safeway store.
